slides.title: You rest until you feel ready.
slides.body: That's usually a minute and a sip of water. Your breathing is ready. Your legs are not.

slides.title: Breath comes back fast. Strength doesn't.
slides.body: Your heart rate settles in about a minute. The fuel for a heavy rep takes three to five minutes.

slides.title: Heavy 3s and 5s: rest 3 to 5 minutes.
slides.body: Yes, really. Start a timer. Put the phone down.

slides.title: Losing reps every set?
slides.body: Same weight, fewer reps, uglier last rep. That isn't your fitness. That's your rest.

slides.title: Accessories can move faster.
slides.body: 60 to 90 seconds is fine for the small stuff. Save the long breaks for the big lifts.

slides.title: Better sets beat more sets.
slides.body: Five sets with full rest build more than eight rushed ones done in the same time.
